title: Gaussian Process Upper Confidence Bound Achieves Nearly Optimal Regret in Noise-Free Gaussian Process Bandits
abstract: arXiv:2502.19006v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study the noise-free Gaussian Process (GP) bandits problem, in which the learner seeks to minimize regret through noise-free observations of the black-box objective function lying on the known reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS). Gaussian process upper confidence bound (GP-UCB) is the well-known GP-bandits algorithm whose query points are adaptively chosen based on the GP-based upper confidence bound score. Although several existing works have reported the practical success of GP-UCB, the current theoretical results indicate its suboptimal performance. However, GP-UCB tends to perform well empirically compared with other nearly optimal noise-free algorithms that rely on a non-adaptive sampling scheme of query points. This paper resolves this gap between theoretical and empirical performance by showing the nearly optimal regret upper bound of noise-free GP-UCB. translated_title: 高斯过程上置信界算法在无噪声高斯过程老虎机问题中实现近乎最优的遗憾值
translated_abstract: 我们研究无噪声高斯过程（GP）老虎机问题，其中学习者试图通过对位于已知再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）中的黑箱目标函数进行无噪声观测来最小化遗憾值。高斯过程上置信界（GP-UCB）是著名的高斯过程老虎机算法，其查询点是基于GP的上置信界分数自适应选择的。尽管已有若干现有工作报道了GP-UCB在实践中的成功，但目前的理论结果表明其性能是次优的。然而，与依赖非自适应查询点采样方案的其他近乎最优的无噪声算法相比，GP-UCB在经验上往往表现更好。本文通过证明无噪声GP-UCB具有近乎最优的遗憾上界，解决了这一理论与实践性能之间的差距。具体而言，我们的分析首次给出了常数累积遗憾……
tldr: 本文首次证明了无噪声GP-UCB算法在无噪声高斯过程老虎机问题中可达到近乎最优的遗憾上界，从而弥合了该算法理论与实践性能之间的差距。
en_tdlr: This paper proves for the first time that noise-free GP-UCB achieves a nearly optimal regret upper bound in noise-free Gaussian process bandits, resolving the gap between its theoretical and empirical performance.
